news.headline: uniQure (QURE) Consensus Price Target Climbs to Roughly $65 as Brokerages Turn More Bullish
news.summary: A roundup of covering brokerages shows the average 12-month price target on QURE has risen to roughly $65 (range cited from about $47 to $108 across different aggregators), with a consensus "Strong/Moderate Buy" rating. The move reflects a broad post-earnings re-rating following the reaffirmed AMT-130 regulatory timeline.

news.headline: Analysts Set Q3 2026 Earnings Expectations for uniQure, Including HC Wainwright's Updated Estimate
news.summary: HC Wainwright's P. Trucchio widened his Q3 2026 loss estimate for uniQure to ($0.90)/share from ($0.84) while reiterating a Buy rating and $80 price target, part of a wider round of sell-side Q3 forecasts issued after the Q2 print. Ratings across the group remain predominantly bullish ahead of the BLA filing and September data readout.

news.headline: Barclays Trims uniQure Price Target to $60 from $65 Despite Keeping Buy Rating; RBC Reiterates Buy
news.summary: In post-earnings notes, Barclays nudged its QURE price target down to $60 (from $65) while maintaining an Overweight/Buy stance, and RBC Capital reiterated its Buy rating, reflecting some caution on near-term financing/dilution even as the regulatory narrative stayed intact.

news.headline: uniQure Reports Q2 2026 Results, Reaffirms Q3 BLA/UK MAA Filing Plans and September Four-Year AMT-130 Data Readout
news.summary: uniQure posted a wider-than-expected Q2 loss (EPS -$1.22 vs. -$0.75 est.) but reaffirmed plans to submit the AMT-130 BLA to the FDA and a UK MHRA MAA in Q3 2026, and to report four-year follow-up data (cUHDRS, TFC, CSF neurofilament light) in September 2026. Management said the $259 million July capital raise extends the cash runway into 2030, and the CMO said the company would welcome a possible FDA advisory committee (AdCom) meeting on AMT-130.

news.headline: Wolfe Research Upgrades uniQure to Outperform, Citing Clearer Path to AMT-130 Approval
news.summary: Wolfe Research raised its rating on QURE to Outperform from Peer Perform following the Q2 update, citing increased confidence in the accelerated-approval pathway for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease after the FDA's June alignment.

news.headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Raises uniQure Price Target to $80 from $47
news.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald sharply raised its price target on uniQure to $80 from $47 while maintaining an Overweight rating, citing an updated Huntington's disease market model and strong patient motivation for a disease-modifying therapy.

catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 data readout
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to present four-year follow-up data (24 patients: 12 high-dose/12 low-dose, plus 3 additional high-dose patients at 3 years) covering cUHDRS, TFC and other functional/cognitive measures vs. a propensity-matched Enroll-HD external control, plus CSF neurofilament light changes from baseline.

catalysts.label: FDA BLA submission for AMT-130 (accelerated approval)
catalysts.detail: Following the June 2026 Type B meeting, the FDA indicated the 3-year Phase I/II analysis can serve as the primary basis for an accelerated-approval BLA in Huntington's disease; management reaffirmed the Q3 2026 filing target on the July 29 earnings call.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) submission
catalysts.detail: After a successful pre-submission meeting with the UK MHRA, uniQure plans to file a parallel MAA for AMT-130 in the UK in Q3 2026, based on the same 3-year dataset.

catalysts.label: Possible FDA Advisory Committee (AdCom) meeting on AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure's chief medical officer said on the Q2 2026 call that the company expects/would welcome an AdCom meeting as part of the BLA review process; not yet formally scheduled by the FDA.

catalysts.label: Confirmatory (post-approval) study design alignment with FDA
catalysts.detail: The FDA has asked uniQure to align on a confirmatory study design (favoring a concurrent standard-of-care control over a sham arm) before/alongside the BLA; final meeting minutes and design agreement are still being finalized.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: uniQure's next quarterly results are expected in the November 2026 timeframe based on historical reporting cadence; exact date not yet announced.

pulse: Sentiment on QURE has turned decisively bullish since the June 2026 FDA reversal cleared an accelerated-approval path for AMT-130, with the July 29 Q2 print reaffirming Q3 2026 BLA/UK MAA filings and a September 2026 four-year data readout, backed by a $259M raise that pushed the cash runway into 2030. Sell-side price targets have kept climbing through early August (consensus now clustering near $65, with individual targets from $46 to $108) even as the stock posted a wider-than-expected quarterly loss and a couple of firms (Barclays) trimmed targets slightly on dilution/financing caution. The next major catalysts are the September four-year data readout and the Q3 BLA/MAA filings, with a possible FDA advisory committee meeting looming as an additional, not-yet-scheduled event.
